launch_scripts.run-gpu.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /lustre/hpc/ocean/nutrik/dev/veris
source .venv-latest/bin/activate
export JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda,cpu
export XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD"
unset JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR
task_results="$PWD/test_logs/vercor-repeat-2026-10-17"
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$task_results/gpu-start.txt"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,uuid,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv > "$task_results/gpu-hardware.csv"
for task_gpu in 0 1; do
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$task_gpu" /usr/bin/time -f 'wall_seconds=%e\npeak_process_rss_kib=%M' -o "$task_results/spherical-gpu-$task_gpu.time" python -m benchmarks.validate_spherical --steps 1000 --output "$task_results/spherical-gpu-$task_gpu.json" > "$task_results/spherical-gpu-$task_gpu.log" 2>&1
done
set +e
/usr/bin/time -f 'wall_seconds=%e\npeak_process_rss_kib=%M' -o "$task_results/gpu-full.time" python -m pytest tests/ -n 1 --dist=loadscope --max-worker-restart=0 -ra --junitxml="$task_results/gpu-full.xml" --basetemp="$task_results/gpu-temp" > "$task_results/gpu-full.log" 2>&1
task_status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_results/gpu-full.exit"
date --iso-8601=seconds > "$task_results/gpu-end.txt"
tail -10 "$task_results/gpu-full.log"
exit "$task_status"

launch_scripts.prepare_gpu_probes.py:
"""Keep existing scientific assertions, adapting only explicit CPU placement."""

import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
output = root / "test_logs/vercor-repeat-2026-10-17"
parent = root / "tests/model_physics_sharding_probe.py"
source = parent.read_text()
assert source.count('"cpu"') == 3
adapted = source.replace('"cpu"', '"gpu"')
adapted = adapted.replace("two-CPU", "two-GPU").replace("CPU devices", "GPU devices")
target = output / "physical-parameters-two-gpu.py"
target.write_text(adapted)
provenance = {
    target.name: {
        "parent": str(parent.relative_to(root)),
        "parent_sha256": hashlib.sha256(parent.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "changes": "Three literal cpu backend selections changed to gpu; success/error labels updated. All comparisons, AD and finite-difference assertions retained.",
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    }
}
parent = root / "tests/grid/test_spherical_operators.py"
tree = ast.parse(parent.read_text())
function = next(
    node for node in tree.body
    if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
    and node.name == "test_spherical_coordinates_survive_non_square_partitioning"
)
assignment = next(
    node for node in function.body
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
    and any(isinstance(name, ast.Name) and name.id == "probe" for name in node.targets)
)
source = ast.literal_eval(assignment.value)
assert source.count("'cpu'") == 2
adapted = source.replace("'cpu'", "'gpu'")
target = output / "spherical-two-gpu.py"
target.write_text(adapted)
provenance[target.name] = {
    "parent": str(parent.relative_to(root)),
    "parent_sha256": hashlib.sha256(parent.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "changes": "Extract original embedded probe; change only two literal cpu backend selections to gpu. All metric/operator comparisons retained.",
    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
(output / "gpu-probe-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n")
print("Prepared two GPU probes with unchanged scientific assertions")
launch_scripts.runner_metadata_negative_control.py:
"""Prove the corrected GPU assertion rejects falsely reported CPU metadata."""

import ast
import importlib
import tempfile
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

import jax
import pytest

from tests.execution.test_runner import (
    test_public_runner_matches_real_simulation_all_fields_and_diagnostics,
)

jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)
assert jax.default_backend() == "gpu"
runtime = importlib.import_module("veris.execution.runtime")
original = runtime._execution_metadata
seen = []


def mislabel(backend, partitions):
    seen.append(backend)
    return original("cpu", partitions)


source = Path("tests/execution/test_runner.py")
assertion = next(
    node.lineno for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text()))
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assert)
    and isinstance(node.test, ast.Compare)
    and isinstance(node.test.left, ast.Subscript)
    and isinstance(node.test.left.slice, ast.Constant)
    and node.test.left.slice.value == "backend"
)
with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    patch.setattr(runtime, "_execution_metadata", mislabel)
    try:
        test_public_runner_matches_real_simulation_all_fields_and_diagnostics(Path(directory))
    except AssertionError as error:
        frame = traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)[-1]
        assert Path(frame.filename).resolve() == source.resolve()
        assert frame.lineno == assertion
        assert seen and all(backend == "gpu" for backend in seen), seen
    else:
        raise AssertionError("ERROR corrected test accepted falsely reported CPU backend")
print("PASS negative control: real GPU run with false CPU metadata rejected at backend assertion")
